evidence.summary: Decreasing linked_badges improved the observed score in the tested range. Query 56 with linked_badges = 20 produced 0.9898, query 71 with linked_badges = 20 produced 0.9899, query 73 with linked_badges = 19 produced 0.9942, and query 74 with linked_badges = 18 produced the current best score of 0.9945. Values below 18 have not yet been tested sufficiently to establish a global optimum.
